title: Validate linked container loading quantities against approved preloading
description: Stage3 priority: implement a core operational integrity gap through existing business APIs/services. Preserve permissions, audit, original evidence and existing layers; no report, UI polish, Agent or production operations.
acceptance_criteria: When existing authorized loading user supplies PreLoadingId, create/update/submit/approve resolves live approved source; reject nonpositive/missing/deleted/cancelled source, missing/deleted products, products absent from source, invalid nonpositive quantities and negative cartons/weight/volume. Use authoritative product base-unit quantities only, aggregate duplicate product lines consistently. Preserve optional unlinked historical documents and multi-customer participant semantics; never invent sales/customer ownership absent from source fields.

Approval atomically locks/reloads preloading source and active approved nondeleted uncancelled linked loading quantities; cumulative quantity per product cannot exceed approved source. Repeated approval cannot duplicate consumption, cancelled/rejected loading releases only its explicit consumption and does not write stock or finance. Prevent source cancellation while effective linked approved loading exists and serialize it against approval. Preserve source/participant/commercial snapshots and existing audit; enforce current module and all applicable customer data scope without expanding access.

Tests exercise partial/exact loading, duplicate lines and cumulative overflow, failed approval unchanged source/target state, explicit cancellation release, invalid source/product, denied identity/customer, unlinked legacy and genuine two-connection approval-versus-approval/source-cancellation races. Reuse original quantity semantics; do not equate cartons with pieces or infer outbound shipment from loading approval.

Real SQL fixtures must require exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance, IntegratedSecurity and NEWERP_AUTOTEST prefix before access. Create only a new GUID-owned database, reject existing database, never drop/reset any database or read production settings. Use SQL generated identities, fail wrong-target guards before access, retain complete logs. Execute relevant unit and safe Release build/test plus real SQL scenarios; build completion does not mean stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: ContainerLoadingListController.Create/Update copies PreLoadingId and details and Calculate only totals. Approve/Cancel inherited from DocumentControllerBase. ContainerPreLoadingController Cancel inherited. Container2.cs existing PreLoadingId and ProductId/Quantity are explicit source fields, but no live source/product or cumulative approved-loading bound is enforced; ERP040/041 shipping/participant annotations do not implement this bound.
